guitar.notes: Steve Miller is well known for playing custom Fender Stratocasters extensively throughout his career.

tone.target: clean-chorus funk rock with bright bite
tone.profile: clean-chorus funk rock with bright bite
tone.summary: A tight, bright signal chain using Comp and Chorus into a Fender-style amp (US Deluxe) paired with US 2x12 cabinet to achieve the required percussive, clean funk sound.
corrections: Use small edge-of-breakup only on peaks

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and maintain tight rhythm definition.
Provide percussive groove and even out dynamics for tight rhythm playing.
Provide slight edge/bite on accents without adding heavy distortion.
blocks.gap: Using Boost instead of a dedicated OD to keep the tone clean and avoid blues crunch.

alternatives.reason: Could provide bite, but might push into unwanted grit.

blocks.purpose: Add light stereo polish and characteristic funk/pop rock shimmer.

Simulate the clean, bright Fender-style tone required for funk rock.
Provide the required bright and focused sound profile (2x12 clue).
Add light stereo polish and depth without sounding muddy or overly wet.

improvements.summary: Upgrade the cabinet IR for increased realism and bite to match the funk rock genre's percussive nature.
